name: Tits of the Dead
source:
A city in the U.S. has turned into a zombie city after a military-developed bacteriological weapon goes off.Tina Gruber, a Special Forces soldier, barely survived, but she is thrown into further danger when she saves a civilian...

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ134647.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
美国一座城市在军方研发的细菌武器爆发后变成了丧尸之城。特种部队士兵蒂娜·格鲁伯勉强活了下来，却在救下一名平民后陷入更大的危险……
